name: Caterpillar - Mossville IL Engine & Research Campus

fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode (40.8429,-89.5632) is GEOMETRIC_CENTER with movedMeters 5 - lands on the western edge of the Caterpillar Mossville Engine & Research Campus (Caterpillar Technical Center). Locked campus center at 40.8445,-89.5565. Confirmed: large multi-building campus with a paved test/proving area and perimeter test track, a cogeneration plant (AES Medina Valley), trailer/material laydown yards, and 7+ large R&D/manufacturing buildings - consistent with the Tech Center (~900k sq ft, ~2,000 scientists/engineers, 24/7).
fieldNotes.truckGate: The campus is access-controlled - Street View covers only the perimeter roads and does not penetrate the interior. An internal entrance road off the perimeter road carries a checkpoint structure; a pipe/conveyor bridge crosses the road near the entrance. Controlled campus entry.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone road-edge guard booth resolvable - the checkpoint sits on the internal entrance road inside the campus. Classified remoteGs (controlled campus, internal checkpoint, no road-visible booth); low confidence.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal entrance roads run long distances across the campus to the building/dock areas - ample queue depth.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide internal roads and paved aprons with abundant unused width - room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~16 dock doors estimated across the building faces - this is an R&D-heavy campus so freight/dock operations are modest; many faces obscured by roof overhang - low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer laydown yards near the north building and south of the manufacturing building, plus material laydown - drop capacity ~40.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock/trailer activity is split between separate building clusters (north R&D/logistics buildings and the south manufacturing building) - likely separate ship/receive; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 8+ large buildings (Tech Center R&D buildings plus manufacturing) - explicitly a campus.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property identified.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - the campus sits among farmland near Mossville/the Illinois River, outside any dense metro fabric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~320 acres for the campus including the test track, cogen plant, buildings and laydown - approximate.
